comments.note: api.js: The workspaces object now mixes plain methods (list, get, create, etc.) with a nested object (launch). This is intentional per the WP spec and creates a consistent sub-namespace pattern. Future external-app launchers should be added as methods on api.workspaces.launch rather than as flat methods on workspaces.

workspace-detail.vscode-button.test.mjs and workspace-detail.open-button.test.mjs: Both test files add a defensive guard (`if (!api.workspaces.launch) api.workspaces.launch = {}`) before patching the spy. This is harmless given api.js now always exports the launch object, but it provides robustness if the import order ever changes.

comments.note: The defensive guard in test files (`if (!api.workspaces.launch) api.workspaces.launch = {}`) is harmless and adds robustness, but is now unnecessary given api.js always exports the launch object. Could be removed in a future cleanup without impact.

The MODULE_TYPELESS_PACKAGE_JSON warning (reparsing api.js as ESM) is a known pre-existing issue. Adding `"type": "module"` to package.json would eliminate the performance overhead, but this is out of scope for WP-002.
